# thousandeyes_emulated_device (Data Source)

Create emulated device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

data "thousandeyes_emulated_device" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `code_name` (String) A code corresponding to the device name.
- `name` (String) The device name
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `available_user_agents` (Set of String) A list of user-agent strings for this emulated device.
- `category` (String) The type of device being emulated.
- `default_user_agent_template` (String) The default user-agent template to use for this device.
- `height` (Number) The height of the display of the emulated device.
- `id` (String) ID of the emulated device.
- `width` (Number) The width of the display of the emulated device.

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`
